entries.displayName: Dynamic Feed: keyless live-data MCP server
entries.description: Keyless Model Context Protocol server for live, verifiable real-world data. Every datapoint is returned in a provenance envelope (source, licence, exact measurement timestamp, age) and Ed25519-signed; records can be independently time-stamped by an independent RFC 3161 authority for proof-of-existence. Coverage includes weather and natural hazards, actively-exploited vulnerabilities (CISA KEV + EPSS), AI-model pricing, flights, satellites and orbital positioning, shipping and sanctions, internet and GPS integrity, and more, each verifiable against the published signing key.
representativeQueries: What changed in the world since my training cutoff?
Does this software package and version have a known CVE?
What is the live weather, forecast, or air quality at a location?
Which CVEs are being actively exploited right now?
Where is this satellite, flight, or vessel right now?

entries.description: REST interface to the same live, signed data layer. Batch-fetch many datapoints in one call via POST /v1/batch, or call per-feed endpoints. Includes a signed go/caution/no-go situational-awareness verdict for robots and agents at a location. Optional X-API-Key; every response is Ed25519-signed and verifies against /.well-known/keys.
representativeQueries: Batch-fetch multiple live signed datapoints in one call
Get a signed go/caution/no-go awareness verdict for a robot at a location

entries.displayName: Dynamic Feed Witness: signed receipts for machine-to-machine transactions
entries.description: A neutral third-party WITNESS for agent-to-agent transactions. POST /v1/witness records a transaction (or just its sha256) as an Ed25519-signed, transparency-logged receipt (txn-receipt/v1) whose hash is time-stamped by an independent RFC 3161 authority and which any party can verify against /.well-known/keys. Dynamic Feed sits BESIDE the transaction and NEVER in the value path. It signs and time-stamps a hash; it never moves, holds, routes or custodies funds. An optional agent co-signature proves which agent key attested. Keyless sample at GET /v1/witness/sample; in-browser verify at /witness.
representativeQueries: Witness an agent-to-agent transaction and return a signed receipt
Prove which AI model actually answered a request (ProofOfModel inference receipt)
Get a black-box receipt for a robot decision, or a notarized un-retunable eval run
Get a tamper-evident, RFC 3161 time-stamped audit trail for agent activity

metadata.note: Witness and receipt rail, not a payment rail. Never moves or custodies funds.
